title: Hot weather is dangerous. Protect your pets.
description:
A heat advisory is in effect for San Diego from 10 a.m. Wednesday until 8 p.m. Thursday. 🌡️ 

Here are a few things to keep in mind when it comes to your pets🐾 :

- Keep them indoors if it's cooler
- Try to exercise them in the early morning or early evening
- Never leave them alone in the car, even if the windows are cracked
- Watch for signs of heat stress like heavy panting, drooling, vomiting, lethargy, or stumbling. If you notice any of these symptoms, visit your vet right away.

#SanDiego #CityOfSanDiego #Heat #petcare
